shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin rebounds above $62,000 in a modest 24-hour recovery, though its weekly performance remains negative.
Ethereum climbs 5.27% to cross the $1,600 mark, despite still underperforming the broader market over the past week.
A robust US jobs report dampens expectations for Fed rate cuts, threatening demand for risk assets like crypto.
Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East spark risk-averse sentiment and potential market volatility.
Solana faces supply pressure from a token unlock while Bitcoin ETFs mark $5 billion in cumulative outflows over 14 days.
